messages.text:
"Implement the PATCH contract in src/parser.ts and src/service.ts. Input is an unknown
plain object with only displayName and tags keys, with Object.prototype or null as its
prototype. Arrays, null and nonobjects are invalid.
Absent fields retain the stored value. displayName null clears it; a string is trimmed
and must have length 1..40 after trimming. tags null or [] clears tags; otherwise tags
is an array of at most five distinct nonempty strings, trimmed before uniqueness checks.
Every tag may have at most 12 characters after trimming. Do not coerce numeric values.
Any invalid field or unknown key throws Error('invalid profile') and leaves storage unchanged.
An empty object is a valid no-op. Return the resulting profile without changing the input
object or reusing the caller's tags array for storage. Begin with ProfileService.patch.

You may change src/ and add or update checks/. Preserve public interfaces unless the request explicitly changes them. Run tsc -p tsconfig.json && node checks/public.cjs and describe the change.
"

input.command: ls -la && cat src/service.ts && cat src/parser.ts && find checks -type f && cat tsconfig.json
cat src/types.ts checks/public.cjs README.md; ls src

content.text:
**Modifying service structure**

I need to focus on modifying the service explicitly at first. It’s already set up to parse atomic elements, so I should restructure and validate the keys to ensure they’re meaningful when logged. The parser will include symbols to reject any issues while accessors don't have robust requirements. I'll pay attention to sparse arrays and ensure iterations handle undefined values correctly, plus I should keep the maximum length in mind. Comprehensive tests will be essential.
I’ll keep validation ahead of all storage updates, then add strict parsing and checks for invalid input, clearing fields, and tag-array isolation.

Implemented strict PATCH validation and atomic updates. Supports trimming, clearing fields, absent-field retention, and no-ops; rejects invalid fields and unknown keys without changing storage. Caller input remains unchanged, and tags are copied.

Expanded checks. Passed `tsc -p tsconfig.json && node checks/public.cjs`.
